description: University naming and UIC-specific terminology from brand.uic.edu.

rules.name: Official name has no "at"
rules.message: Don't put "at" between Illinois and Chicago. The official name is University of Illinois Chicago.

rules.name: No hyphen or punctuation in the name
rules.message: Don't put a hyphen (or other punctuation) between Illinois and Chicago.

rules.name: No periods in UIC
rules.message: The acronym is "UIC" with no periods.
rules.source: Inferred from UIC Name and boilerplate (official acronym "UIC")

rules.name: Unofficial abbreviation of the name
rules.message: The only approved short form is "UIC".
rules.source: Inferred from UIC Name and boilerplate (official acronym "UIC")

rules.name: Abbreviated university name
rules.message: Use the full name, University of Illinois Chicago, or "UIC".
rules.source: Inferred from UIC Name and boilerplate (use the full name wherever possible)

rules.name: Full name on first reference
rules.message: Spell out University of Illinois Chicago on first reference; "UIC" is fine afterward.
rules.source: UIC Name and boilerplate (use the full name wherever possible; applied to all audiences and channels by team decision)

rules.name: UIC is always uppercase
rules.message: Write "UIC" in capital letters (web and email addresses are fine).
rules.source: Inferred from UIC Name and boilerplate (official acronym "UIC")

rules.name: Redundant "UIC University"
rules.source: Inferred from UIC Name and boilerplate

rules.name: Incomplete name "Illinois Chicago"
rules.message: Use the full name, University of Illinois Chicago, or "UIC".
rules.source: Inferred from UIC Name and boilerplate

rules.name: Former campus name (Chicago Circle)
rules.pattern: \b(?:University of Illinois at )?Chicago Circle(?! Center)(?: Campus)?\b|\bUICC\b
rules.message: Chicago Circle / UICC are former names. Use University of Illinois Chicago or UIC unless you are writing about history.
rules.source: UIC Editorial guide: UIC Student Center East (former names)

rules.name: "University of Illinois" alone is ambiguous
rules.message: Use "University of Illinois" sparingly; the public usually takes it to mean Urbana-Champaign. Name the campus.
rules.source: UIC Editorial guide: University of Illinois System

rules.name: "U of I" alone is ambiguous
rules.message: "U of I" is approved only in "U of I System". Use "UIC" for this university.
rules.source: UIC Editorial guide: University of Illinois System

rules.name: Lowercase "university" when it stands alone
rules.message: Capitalize "university" only in formal names; lowercase it when it stands alone.

rules.name: No "(UIC)" after the full name
rules.message: Don't put "UIC" in parentheses after the full name. Just use "UIC" on later references.
rules.source: UIC Name and boilerplate; Editorial guide: University of Illinois Chicago

rules.name: The "C rule": space after UIC
rules.message: Always put a space between UIC and the next word, and don't let the C in UIC start the next word (not "UICampus").

rules.name: UI Health naming

pattern.UI Health College of: University of Illinois Chicago College of

rules.message: Use current UI Health names. Don't use outdated names or acronyms; health science colleges, faculty and the cancer center are not branded "UI Health".
rules.source: UIC Editorial guide: UI Health; University of Illinois Cancer Center

rules.name: Former names of UIC units and buildings

pattern.John Marshall Law School: University of Illinois Chicago School of Law

rules.message: This is a former name. Use the current name.
rules.source: UIC Editorial guide: Student Center East/West; School of Law; System Offices

rules.name: UIC proper names and spellings
rules.message: Use the official spelling of this UIC name.
rules.source: UIC Editorial guide: Great Cities Commitment; Jane Addams Hull-House Museum; UIC today; Department names

rules.name: Campus regions
rules.message: Avoid "east campus" and "west campus"; they imply separate campuses.
